options.label: Godslayer
options.help: The one blade that can wound and kill a god. Off: gods cannot be hurt.

options.label: Godslayer recipe
options.help: Mortals may craft it from a nether star, a heavy core and more.

options.label: God's health
options.help: A god's full health against the Godslayer.

options.label: Blow, weakest
options.help: Least health one full blow takes.

options.label: Blow, strongest
options.help: Most health one full blow takes.

options.label: Blade damage
options.help: The Godslayer's damage to mortals and beasts.

options.label: Ascended kills
options.help: The Ascended Godslayer kills a god in one blow.

options.label: Ascended damage
options.help: The Ascended blade's damage to mortals.

options.label: Heals after
options.help: Wounds start closing this long after the last blow.

options.label: Healing
options.help: Health a god regains each minute once healing.

options.label: Slain god returns
options.help: Off: a slain god stays dead until /god revive.

options.label: Returns after
options.help: How long a slain god stays dead when it returns.

options.label: Blade's aura
options.help: Soul fire trails the held blade, which hums.

options.label: Apotheosis
options.help: Its rarest gift: it may raise a beloved mortal to demigod (wings, strength, flight).

options.label: Apotheosis wait
options.help: Hours before the gift can be given again.

options.label: Favor to ascend
options.help: Lowest favor a mortal needs to be raised.

options.label: Divinity lasts
options.help: How long a demigod stays one (0 = until unmade).

options.label: Demigods fly
options.help: Demigods may fly.

options.label: Demigods at once
options.help: How many demigods may live at the same time.

options.label: Health bar reach
options.help: How near players must be to see a wounded god's health.
